requirements_summary: SMB chat/support workload on hosted API. Primary concerns: predictable burst handling and clear quota upgrade options. Targets: median response latency <600ms for short chats, 95th <1.5s, concurrent active sessions ~40-120 during peak campaigns, occasional spikes to 400+ concurrent for 10-20 minutes.
